description: Election Commission - P. A. Sulakshana was Elected as the Member of Nanattan P.S.
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Nanattan Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a member ceasing to belong to their party and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new elected member by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and declarations, making it a Type 7 (Elections) gazette.
